request.purpose: Pick up a round/spherical object and slowly lower it into a container, releasing it near the container bottom so it does not bounce, roll, or perch on the rim, ending up inside the container.

import math

def lower_into_container(robot, scene, obj, container):
    for attempt in range(2):
        cont = scene.get(container.name)
        target = scene.get(obj.name)
        robot.pick(target)

        ex, ey, ez, eyaw = robot.ee_pose()
        ox, oy, oz, oyaw = scene.pose(target)
        dz = ez - oz

        cont = scene.get(container.name)
        cpos = scene.pose(cont)
        cx = cpos[0]
        cy = cpos[1]
        cz = cpos[2]
        cont_top = cz + cont.h / 2.0
        floor_z = cz - cont.h / 2.0

        obj_half_h = target.h / 2.0
        safe_ee_z = cont_top + dz + obj_half_h + 4.0
        safe_ee_z = max(safe_ee_z, ez, 18.0)

        robot.move_ee(ex, ey, safe_ee_z, speed=0.5)
        robot.move_ee(cx, cy, safe_ee_z, speed=0.5)

        release_obj_z = floor_z + obj_half_h + 0.4
        target_ee_z = release_obj_z + dz

        cur_z = safe_ee_z
        while cur_z > target_ee_z + 0.01:
            nxt = max(target_ee_z, cur_z - 4.0)
            robot.move_ee(cx, cy, nxt, speed=0.25)
            cur_z = nxt
        robot.wait(0.5)

        robot.grip("open")
        robot.wait(0.8)

        robot.move_ee(cx, cy, min(safe_ee_z, target_ee_z + 5.0), speed=0.25)
        robot.move_ee(cx, cy, safe_ee_z, speed=0.5)
        robot.wait(1.0)

        fresh_obj = scene.get(obj.name)
        fresh_cont = scene.get(container.name)
        inside = scene.is_inside(fresh_obj, fresh_cont)
        log(f"lower_into_container attempt {attempt}: obj {scene.pose(fresh_obj)} cont {scene.pose(fresh_cont)} inside={inside}")
        if inside:
            break
    robot.home()
